acceptance.criterion: Print the mathematical sum of integer arguments, preserving sign.
acceptance.evidence: signed_sum.py:3 returns sum(values); line 5 parses arguments with int and prints the result. An inline python3 -B harness verified 11 real CLI invocations, each using python3 -B, with exact stdout, exit 0, and empty stderr. Coverage included single integers, zero, explicit positive signs, and integers beyond 64-bit range.
The real CLI without arguments printed '0\n'; test_empty passed.
The real CLI with -2 -3 printed '-5\n'; test_negative passed.

acceptance.criterion: Mixed signs produce the correct signed total.
acceptance.evidence: CLI arguments -7 2, -2 7, and -3 3 printed -5, 5, and 0 respectively. All corresponding test_mixed_signs subtests passed.
The real CLI with 2 3 printed '5\n'. The original positive assertion remains unchanged and passed.
